steps.content: **WHEN** the HHD is powered back on and the operator signs in
steps.expected:
**THEN** the operator re-enters their PIN and the session resumes within 3 minutes
**AND** **UNCONFIRMED** — interrupted transaction resolves without duplication — not evidenced in requirements; confirm before running

change_note: Refs FBD-100373 (Refund on POS — unrelated topic) replaced with REQ-0105.0 (HHD requires PIN re-entry, ID pre-populated, after battery removed/replaced) and REQ-0105.1 (<3 min to become fully operational). The session-recovery claim is now grounded; the 'resolved without duplication' claim for a transaction interrupted mid-payment is not evidenced anywhere in the requirements library — marked UNCONFIRMED and logged to the gap register.

Refs corrected from FBD-100373 (Refund on POS — wrong topic, no battery/power content) to REQ-0105.0 (PIN re-entry after battery replace) + REQ-0105.1 (<3 min to become operational). Case text already matches these requirements; citation-only fix.
Refs corrected from FBD-100373 (unrelated) to REQ-1389.1 (HHD raises alert below low-battery threshold) + REQ-1389.3 (HHD monitors battery level against configured thresholds). Citation-only fix.
Refs corrected from FBD-100167 (Multiple Use Barcodes — unrelated) to REQ-1741.0 (device shall notify operator of a print failure/partial print). Citation-only fix.

preconds:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on with an unpaired HHD
**AND** **GAP** — external-printer + NFC-pairing mechanism not in requirements: the HHD has an integrated thermal printer (REQ-0819.6) and the only documented pairing is HHD↔M020 payment terminal over Bluetooth (FBD-100320), not a printer over NFC — confirm on the live system before running
change_note: No spec or requirement in the library describes an external printer or an NFC-based printer-pairing procedure for the HHD — REQ-0819.6 says the HHD has its own integrated 2" thermal printer, and the only device pairing on record (FBD-100320) is the HHD↔M020 payment terminal, over Bluetooth. This looks like a possible cross-surface mix-up (M020 pairing mistaken for a printer). Marked GAP rather than corrected; logged to gap register for engineer confirmation of whether an external/NFC-paired printer variant exists at all.

preconds:
**GIVEN** an operator is signed on with a live CloudFare connection
**AND** the HHD's own network connection is lost for a sustained period
change_note: FBD-100359 names the Ethernet-connected devices affected by a Translink-network outage (Way6 POS, T1 Dock, Retail Kiosk, Platform & Gate Validators) and states cellular devices are unaffected — the HHD is cellular, so citing FBD-100359 for 'a network outage takes the HHD offline' overstated the source. Reworded the precondition to the HHD's own connection being down (device-level, not a Translink-network event) and re-cited REQ-2576.0 (device shall lock out after a configurable period without successful communication), which is device-agnostic and does apply.

preconds: **GIVEN** the HHD holds transactions queued during a period its own network connection was down
change_note: Reworded for consistency with the 4103998 correction (HHD is cellular, not one of the Ethernet devices FBD-100359 says get comms-locked by a Translink-network outage). The queue-then-deliver-via-RabbitMQ-on-restore mechanism itself is back-office-side and device-agnostic, so FBD-100359 still grounds it; added REQ-2576.0 for the device-side lockout/reconnect behaviour.

Refs corrected from FBD-100359 (SaaS network impact — architecture doc, no device-UI content) to REQ-2854.0 (operator wants the device to display network details to be informed of connectivity status). Citation-only fix.
Refs corrected from FBD-100373 (Refund on POS — unrelated) to REQ-0437.0 (HHD panic button sends an immediate event to the Back Office, which alerts subscribed users). Citation-only fix.

preconds:
**GIVEN** an HHD is available for a Translink-managed OS upgrade
**AND** **GAP** — specific 'OS 7'/'OS 8' version numbers are not in requirements; confirm the actual current and target Android OS versions before running
change_note: Refs corrected from FBD-100359 (unrelated) to REQ-0569.0 (system manages distribution of device OS/firmware updates) + REQ-1618.0 (HHD hosts an Android OS). The general upgrade capability is evidenced; the specific 'OS 7 → OS 8' version pairing is not found anywhere in the requirements library — marked GAP and logged to the gap register rather than asserted as fact.

Refs corrected from FBD-100651 (Glider Tap On Only — wrong scope) to REQ-3364.0 (contactless/DESFire read <500ms) + REQ-3365.0 (MIFARE Classic read <=800ms). No literal value added to case text — 'expected response time' is left as the assumed-configured value per the standard.

Added REQ-3132.0 (device shall proceed with scanning barcodes within one second) alongside the existing FBD-100167 citation — both support the 1-second read-to-beep claim; the original ref was topically correct but thinly attributed.
Refs corrected from FBD-100373 (Refund on POS — unrelated) to REQ-0050.0 (system authenticates users and validates sign-on). Citation-only fix.

Refs corrected from FBD-100373 (Refund on POS — unrelated) to REQ-0163.4 (device auto-prints a ticket on successful cash/EMV/warrant payment). 'Adult Single' is a confirmed HHD NIR product (HHD NIR Products config, product 513); the £2.30 fare is a configured value not separately verified in this library — treat as an example of current pricing config, not a pinned constant.
Dropped FBD-100373 (Refund on POS — unrelated); kept FBD-100320 (HHD↔M020 pairing is Bluetooth, correctly cited already) and added REQ-0163.4 (auto-print ticket on successful payment).

Refs corrected from FBD-100373 (Refund on POS) — that spec explicitly states refund is a different process from annulment, so citing it for an annulment case had it backwards. Corrected to REQ-0300.0 (operator can annul transactions) + REQ-0300.1 (annul any ticket issued in the current duty).
Refs corrected from FBD-100651 (Glider Tap On Only — wrong scope, PV/HHD-inspection only) to REQ-0871.0 (validate the Translink Adult Metro Multi-Journey smartcard product).
Refs corrected from FBD-100373 (Refund on POS — unrelated) to REQ-0329.0/REQ-0329.1 (HHD prints a waybill when the operator ends duty). Citation-only fix.
